payload.title: Solar-climate connections over the Common Era
payload.description: This notebook investigates the hypothesis that variations in solar irradiance contribute to the variability in global mean surface temperature (GMST) over the Common Era. Using the Pyleoclim library, the notebook performs wavelet transform coherency analysis between solar irradiance and GMST reconstructions. It also quantifies phase relationships using phase statistics.
